title: Terms & conditions
description: Terms for using Kromacut: open-source licensing, artwork rights, print checks, local backups, community support, and legal protections.

sections.title: About Kromacut and these terms
paragraphs: Kromacut is a personally operated, open-source tool that turns images into color-layered 3D models. The browser app and desktop releases are free to use. No Kromacut account or Patreon membership is required to edit images or export models.

These terms describe use of the Kromacut website and app, practical responsibilities when preparing prints, and the available support channels. paragraphs: Kromacut does not claim ownership of the images, palettes, profiles, or models you bring to or create with the app. Processing a file locally does not grant the operator permission to publish or reuse it.

You are responsible for having the rights or permission needed for your images and for any prints or files you share or sell. Using Kromacut does not remove another person's copyright, trademark, privacy, or other rights. Artwork shown in examples or community posts is not automatically licensed for your reuse.

sections.title: Check every model before printing
paragraphs: Kromacut's previews, color predictions, hiding-distance calculations, calibration results, and print instructions are aids to planning. They do not guarantee an exact physical color match, a successful print, or suitability for a particular purpose. Materials, lighting, calibration, printer setup, and slicer settings affect the result.

Inspect each exported STL or 3MF in your slicer. Check dimensions, geometry, orientation, layer heights, first-layer height, nozzle and extrusion settings, filament assignments, and swaps before starting the printer. Recheck after changing settings or updating the app, and use a small test print where appropriate.

Follow your printer and filament manufacturers' safety instructions. An export is not an engineering assessment or safety certification. Any safety-critical, load-bearing, medical, or other regulated use needs independent checks appropriate to that use.

sections.title: Local data and backups
paragraphs: Kromacut processes artwork on your device and does not provide cloud project storage or a recovery service for your local files. Browser or app storage can be cleared, lost, or become unavailable.

Keep your original images and export backups of important palettes, filament profiles, and calibration history, especially before clearing storage, changing devices, or updating the app. Save exported models somewhere you can find again. The operator cannot remotely recover data held only on your device.
The privacy notice explains saved settings, website requests, email correspondence, and privacy choices. It is information about data handling, not a request for blanket consent.

sections.title: Help and community channels
paragraphs: The main channels for Kromacut help are r/kromacut on Reddit and the Kromacut Discord server. Documentation is also available in the app and on this website. Unless separately agreed or required by law, community help does not come with a guaranteed response time, fix, or implementation date.

Follow the platform and community rules when participating. Reddit posts and shared Discord channels may be visible to other people; avoid posting sensitive information or files you do not want to share. Advice from other community members is their own and should be checked before printing.
Use the public email below for questions about these terms or a private concern. Privacy requests can use the contact described in the privacy notice.

Releases may change features, file compatibility, and predictions. Read the release notes, keep backups, and verify regenerated results. Changes to hosting or this page do not revoke rights granted under the license for copies you already received.
